<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="321" y1="15" x2="321" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="12" x2="326" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="9" x2="331" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="15" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="19" x2="349" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="359" y="9" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="11" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="382" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="35,57 25,67 35,77" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">PROFILE SETUP</text>
    <rect x="59" y="92" width="272" height="5" rx="3" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="59" y="92" width="136" height="5" rx="3" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="331" y="96" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">3 OF 6</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="157" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">How tall are you?</text>
    <text x="195" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">This helps us find your best matches.</text>
    <text x="195" y="207" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You can change this later in your profile.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Height value card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="70" y="237" width="250" height="130" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="276" r="30" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="195" y="287" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">5′ 10″</text>
    <text x="195" y="327" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">YOUR HEIGHT</text>
    <rect x="143" y="344" width="104" height="25" rx="13" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="195" y="361" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">FEET / INCHES</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ruler and slider -->
  <g>
    <text x="45" y="418" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">HEIGHT</text>
    <text x="345" y="418" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">4′ 0″ — 7′ 0″</text>
    <rect x="45" y="447" width="300" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="45" y="447" width="180" height="6" rx="3" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <circle cx="225" cy="450" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="467" x2="45" y2="477" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="95" y1="467" x2="95" y2="477" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="145" y1="467" x2="145" y2="477" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="467" x2="195" y2="477" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="245" y1="467" x2="245" y2="477" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="295" y1="467" x2="295" y2="477" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="467" x2="345" y2="477" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="45" y="494" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">4′</text>
    <text x="195" y="494" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">5′ 6″</text>
    <text x="345" y="494" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">7′</text>
    <path d="M218 430 Q225 421 232 430" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M215 434 Q225 420 235 434" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1" opacity=".45"/>
    <path d="M51 512 Q195 525 339 512" fill="none" stroke="#F5F7FA" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Unit selector -->
  <g>
    <text x="45" y="557" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">MEASUREMENT</text>
    <rect x="45" y="572" width="300" height="42" rx="21" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <rect x="47" y="574" width="146" height="38" rx="19" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="120" y="598" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">FEET / INCHES</text>
    <text x="269" y="598" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">CENTIMETERS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="57" y="655" width="276" height="48" rx="24" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="685" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="730" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your height is only visible to people you match with.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="39,793 50,783 61,793 61,805 53,805 53,797 47,797 47,805 39,805" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="50" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">DISCOVER</text>

    <g transform="translate(127,790)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="7" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="10" cy="18" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
    <text x="137" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>

    <g transform="translate(209,789)">
      <rect x="0" y="2" width="21" height="15" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="5,17 5,22 11,17" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="7" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="11" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="15" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    </g>
    <text x="220" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">CHATS</text>

    <g transform="translate(300,789)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="10" y1="5" x2="10" y2="15" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="5" y1="10" x2="15" y2="10" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
    <text x="310" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">SETTINGS</text>
  </g>
</svg>
